# Introduction

https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/seurat5_spatial_vignette_2#mouse-brain-10x-genomics-xenium-in-situ

## Load Xenium Object

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align = 'center'}

xenium.obj <- LoadXenium(here("output-XETG00402__0054800__Region_1__20250822__221946"), fov = "fov")

xenium.obj

head(xenium.obj@meta.data)
```

### Visualize Xenium object

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align = 'center'}

Boundaries(xenium.obj[["fov"]])

ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, cols = "polychrome", size = 0.75)

```


## Add Clinical information into meta.data

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align = 'center'}

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, features = c("nFeature_Xenium", "nCount_Xenium"), ncol = 2, pt.size = 0)

# remove cells with 0 counts
xenium.obj <- subset(xenium.obj, subset = nCount_Xenium > 0)

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, features = c("nFeature_Xenium", "nCount_Xenium"), ncol = 2, pt.size = 0)

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, features = c("nFeature_Xenium", "nCount_Xenium"), ncol = 2)

high_count_cells <- xenium.obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(nCount_Xenium > 2500) %>%
  rownames()

df_export <- data.frame(
  cell_id = high_count_cells,
  group   = "Higher_than_2500_counts"
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("row") %>%
  select(-row)

# Save as CSV
write.csv(df_export, "cellid_higher_than_2500_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

Increasing PCA dims to 50

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align = 'center'}

xenium.obj <- SCTransform(xenium.obj, assay = "Xenium")
xenium.obj <- RunPCA(xenium.obj, npcs = 50, features = rownames(xenium.obj))
xenium.obj <- RunUMAP(xenium.obj, dims = 1:50)
xenium.obj <- FindNeighbors(xenium.obj, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)
xenium.obj <- FindClusters(xenium.obj, resolution = 2)

DimPlot(xenium.obj, group.by = "SCT_snn_res.1")


markers.to.plot1 <- c("Lrp2",         # PTS1, PTS2, PTS3
                      "Slc5a12",      # PTS1
                      "Slc13a3",      # PTS2
                      "Slc16a9",      # PTS3
                      "Epha7",        # DTL
                      "Cryab",        # DTL
                      "Slc12a1",      # TALA, TALB, MD
                      "Cldn16",       # TALA
                      "Cldn10",       # TALB
                      "Nos1",         # MD
                      "Slc12a3",      # DCT1, DCT2
                      "Egf",          # DCT1
                      "Slc8a1",       # CNT, DCT2
                      "Aqp2",         # PC
                      "Slc4a1",       # ICA
                      "Kit",          # ICA
                      "Slc26a4",      # ICB
                      "Nphs1",        # PODO
                      "Ncam1",        # PEC
                      "Upk1b",        # URO
                      "Flt1",         # EC
                      "Emcn",         # EC
                      "Lyve1",        # LYMPH
                      "Kdr",          # LYMPH
                      "Pdgfra",       # FIB
                      "Pdgfrb",       # FIB, MES, VSMC
                      "Piezo2",       # MES
                      "Acta2",        # VSMC
                      "Ptprc",        # LYMPHO, MACRO
                      "Skap1",        # LYMPHO
                      "Cd74"          # MACRO
)

p1 <- DotPlot(xenium.obj,
features = markers.to.plot1,
dot.scale = 8,
dot.min = 0,
scale.max = 100,
scale.min = 0,
col.min = -2.5,
col.max = 2.5) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Gene Features", y = "Clusters")

p1

```

## Translate Xenium Explorer Clusters to Seurat

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align = 'center'}

cells <- read_csv("Selection_1_cells_stats.csv", skip = 2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%                   # dplyr/tibble prefers explicit cols
  column_to_rownames(var = colnames(.)[1])   # use first column as rownames

xenium.obj <- AddMetaData(xenium.obj, cells)

head(xenium.obj@meta.data)

DimPlot(xenium.obj)

DimPlot(xenium.obj, group.by = "Cluster")

t4 <- table(xenium.obj@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.1, xenium.obj@meta.data$Cluster)

t5 <- t(t4)

prop.t1 <- prop.table(t5, margin = 2) 
prop.t1

t5 <- as.data.frame(prop.t1)
colnames(t5) <- c('Cell_type', 'Group', 'Frequency')

# Original plot

ggplot(t5, aes(fill=Cell_type, y=Frequency, x=Group)) + 
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity", fun.y = "mean", colour="black") +
  theme_classic()

prop.t2 <- prop.table(t4, margin = 2) 
prop.t2

t4 <- as.data.frame(prop.t2)
colnames(t4) <- c('Cell_type', 'Group', 'Frequency')


ggplot(t4, aes(fill=Cell_type, y=Frequency, x=Group)) + 
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity", fun.y = "mean", colour="black") +
  theme_classic()

xenium.obj@meta.data <- xenium.obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(high_count = ifelse(nCount_Xenium > 2500, "yes", "no"))

head(xenium.obj@meta.data)

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, "Area (µm^2)", group.by = "high_count")


xenium.obj@meta.data$high_count <- factor(
  xenium.obj@meta.data$high_count,
  levels = c("yes", "no")
)
DimPlot(xenium.obj, group.by = "high_count", order = T)

unique(xenium.obj@meta.data$segmentation_method)

DimPlot(xenium.obj, group.by = "segmentation_method", order = T)


mosaicplot(table(xenium.obj$SCT_snn_res.1, xenium.obj$segmentation_method))

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, "nCount_Xenium", group.by = "segmentation_method")

```

```{r echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align = 'center'}

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, "nCount_Xenium")

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, "nFeature_Xenium")

    seurat_clusters == 7  ~ "PTS2",
    seurat_clusters == 8  ~ "DCT2",
    seurat_clusters == 9  ~ "TALB",
    seurat_clusters == 10 ~ "IntX",
    seurat_clusters == 11 ~ "EC2",
    seurat_clusters == 12 ~ "PODO",
    seurat_clusters == 13 ~ "CNT",
    seurat_clusters == 14 ~ "IMM",
    seurat_clusters == 15 ~ "TALweak",
    seurat_clusters == 16 ~ "FIB",
    seurat_clusters == 17 ~ "mPC",
    seurat_clusters == 18 ~ "VSMC",
    seurat_clusters == 19 ~ "cPC",
    seurat_clusters == 20 ~ "ICA",
    seurat_clusters == 21 ~ "PTS1",
    seurat_clusters == 22 ~ "mFIB",
    seurat_clusters == 23 ~ "ECweak",
    seurat_clusters == 24 ~ "MedX1",
    seurat_clusters == 25 ~ "PTS2weak",
    seurat_clusters == 26 ~ "MedX2",
    seurat_clusters == 27 ~ "MedX3",
    seurat_clusters == 28 ~ "Unknown",
    seurat_clusters == 29 ~ "URO",
    seurat_clusters == 30 ~ "FIBweak",

# Get cell IDs and cluster assignments
df_export <- data.frame(
  cell_id = Cells(xenium.obj),

# Save as CSV
write.csv(df_export, "cellid_subclass_cluster_export.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
